tasks.dev: deno task build && deno run -A serve.ts
tasks.build: deno eval "await Deno.mkdir('dist/icons',{recursive:true})" && deno bundle --platform browser ui/main.tsx -o dist/bundle.js && deno eval "for (const file of ['index.html','styles.css','manifest.json','sw.js']) await Deno.copyFile('ui/'+file,'dist/'+file); for (const icon of ['icon-192.png','icon-512.png']) await Deno.copyFile('ui/icons/'+icon,'dist/icons/'+icon)"
tasks.check: deno fmt --check && deno lint && deno check ui/main.tsx
tasks.smoke: deno task build && deno run -A tests/smoke.ts
